title: Bitcoin price falls as US-Iran tensions rattle risk assets
title_zh: 由于美伊紧张局势影响风险资产，比特币价格下跌
summary: Bitcoin price slipped on Thursday as escalating geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran weighed on broader risk sentiment.
summary_zh: 由于美国和伊朗之间不断升级的地缘政治紧张局势打压了更广泛的风险情绪，比特币价格周四下跌。

title: FTSE 100 LIVE: Stocks slump as miners and British Gas owner Centrica pull London lower

summary_zh: Centrica 在 2025 年全年利润下降 39% 后宣布停止股票回购计划。

title: Google, Shopee-owner Sea to develop AI tools for e-commerce, gaming
title_zh: 谷歌与 Shopee 母公司 Sea 合作开发用于电子商务、游戏的人工智能工具
summary: Alphabet Inc's Google and Southeast Asian technology conglomerate Sea Ltd announced ‌a new tie-up on Thursday that will ‌develop artificial intelligence tools for Sea's e-commerce and gaming products.
summary_zh: Alphabet Inc 旗下的谷歌和东南亚科技集团 Sea Ltd 周四宣布建立新的合作伙伴关系，将为 Sea 的电子商务和游戏产品开发人工智能工具。

title: Average monthly mortgage payments fell £119 in the year to January
title_zh: 截至 1 月份的一年中，平均每月抵押贷款付款下降了 119 英镑
summary: The average monthly mortgage payment in Britain fell to £1,592 in January, according to Rightmove.
summary_zh: Rightmove 的数据显示，1 月份英国平均每月抵押贷款支付额降至 1,592 英镑。

title: Samsung Shares Surge to Record After Report on Higher Chip Price
title_zh: 芯片价格上涨的报道传出后，三星股价飙升至创纪录水平
summary: The chipmaker’s stock rose as much as 5.4% on Korea Exchange, as the market reopened following a three-day holiday.  Samsung is looking to price its HBM4 at around $700 per unit, according to Chosun Ilbo newspaper.  Samsung declined to comment on the media report.
summary_zh: 随着市场在三天假期后重新开盘，这家芯片制造商的股票在韩国证券交易所上涨了 5.4%。  据《朝鲜日报》报道，三星希望将 HBM​​4 定价为每台 700 美元左右。  三星拒绝对媒体报道发表评论。
